intro: Proof of Demise is a military directive issued by Deathguard Burgess in Brill to thin the ranks of the Scarlet Crusade in Tirisfal Glades. Initiated on the orders of Varimathras, Sylvanas Windrunner's dreadlord lieutenant, it tests a soldier's loyalty to the Forsaken cause. Recruits are ordered to strip signet rings from fallen crusaders as tangible evidence of their slaughter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing Scarlet Crusaders. Tirisfal Glades is crawling with them.

Varimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of Azeroth, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in Tirisfal Glades we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The Scarlet Crusade.
Venture forth and wage an offensive on the Scarlet Crusade, adventurer. Bring me back 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.

clips.title: Progress

clips.title: Completion
